motivation.text: Effort is not a mood. It is a hand you extend toward the day.

discipline.text: The alarm rings. You get up anyway. Tomorrow trusts the small thing you finish today.

money.text: The money you keep is the money that buys your future freedom.

mindset.text: Perspective is a slower voice than panic, and it usually tells the truth.

fact.text: The Eiffel Tower can grow taller in summer as heat expands the iron.

books.text: We build confidence from what we know and ignore the rare event that changes everything.
books.credit: Idea from The Black Swan by Nassim Nicholas Taleb

stoic.text: Want what arrives, not what you demanded; the day stops fighting you.
